say:0:1460449001:1.text: Brendan's symptoms provide the missing puzzle piece to your new recipe.
say:0:1460449001:1.source_cn: 宾塔的症状补全了你此前一直无法找到的灵感。

say:1:1460449002:1.text: You conclude that the patients experience a warped sense of reality due to being too absorbed in their mental world.
say:1:1460449002:1.source_cn: 你判断，患者们都是过于沉浸于情感与精神世界，反而影响到...

say:2:1460449003:1.text: In mild cases, patients become deeply engrossed in their imaginary relationships. But in more severe cases, they experience devastating heartbreak when their fantasies collapse.
say:2:1460449003:1.source_cn: 轻者只是沉迷恋爱与妄想，但重者则会因为幻想的破灭尝到心...

say:3:1460449004:1.text: You decide to use what's available in the garden to prepare a recipe for them.
say:3:1460449004:1.source_cn: 你决定，从苗圃里现有的药材中挑选适合的来制作药剂。
